messages.subject: Strange results
parts:
Hello everyone,

In the context of my thesis I develop JSDM models on Nimble.

In this purpose I use the Wishart distribution to have my prior of a covariance matrix that I transform into correlation matrix. 

So I tried two possibilities :
1) the first one is to use the wishart for the prior of the covariance matrix, then transform it into correlation matrix, then use my correlation matrix in the dmnorm and finally use the result in the logit with a correction. It is working perfectly fine. But I wanted to use the covariance matrix in order to have no correction at the end. So :

2)  the second one is to use the wishart for the prior of the covariance matrix, then transform it into correlation matrix, then use my covariance matrix instead of the correlation matrix in the dmnorm and finally use the result in the logit (without correction). And I don't know why but the results are totally absurd because my correlation matrix does not have values between -1 and 1 and the way I calculate it is suppose to give values between -1 and 1. I do not understand why because I calculate it exactly the same way. The only thing that is different is in the dmnorm (covar instead of corr) and then in logit the correction.

You will find attach the two scripts with simulation of datas at the beginning (in a very simple way it is just to test if the models are running and the results possible). You will also find the function needed to simulate the datas (unlist)
I thought at first it was because corr was only calculate but then not used so Nimble did not update it, so I tried to add a line that have no use, just to use corr (called "pipo" in the script) but this solution does not work either. 

PS: for the calculation of corr, if I don't use max(i,j),min(i,j) I don't have a symmetric matrix. Is the Wishart distribution not suppose to be symmetric by definition? 
That gives symmetric matrix : corr[i,j]<-covar[max(i,j),min(i,j)]/sqrt(covar[i,i]*covar[j,j])
But I would expect that this notation would also work if wishart is symmetric : corr[i,j]<-covar[i,j]/sqrt(covar[i,i]*covar[j,j])

Thank you in advance for your most welcome help

Ugoline
